protocol: Claude protocol: a budgeted cost and accuracy probe for proposal clustering (Tal Yaron & Fany Yuval, 11 Sep 2026)
question: What do you believe should change in Bowling Green/Warren County in order to make it a better place to live, work and spend time?

source.name: Pol.is openData — american-assembly.bowling-green
source.license: CC BY 4.0 — attribution to The Computational Democracy Project (Polis)
source.eligibility: moderated == 1, non-empty, first occurrence of each normalised text; author-id dropped

budget.note: main cap = $3 main allocation + $0.75 retry reserve; the hard total is enforced separately

judge.reasoningEffortNote: not sent, matching production (functions/src/config/openai-chat.ts buildModelParams); provider default is 'medium' per the model page

embedding.note: production embeds a generated 5-15 word brief (EMBEDDING_USE_BRIEF defaults true); this minimal probe embeds original text with the same question prefix and makes no brief calls

screeningEmbedding.use: annotation shortlist only — never used by method B

retrieval.method: exact cosine over the pool, ties by id; not the production approximate index (findNearest limit 45, floor 0.45)
